description: This file defines a PHP interface 'ResourceEndpoint' in the namespace 'OrangeHRM\Core\Api\V2'. It specifies a contract for API resource endpoints, including methods for CRUD operations (getOne, update, delete) and validation rule retrieval for each operation. The interface references external exception classes, a result class, and a parameter rule collection, establishing a standardized structure for API endpoints within the OrangeHRM HRM system.

classes.name: ResourceEndpoint
classes.description: A PHP interface defining CRUD and validation rule methods for API resource endpoints in the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Method to retrieve one resource; may throw exceptions for normalization, not found, not implemented, or forbidden conditions.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Provides validation rules for the 'getOne' method, may throw a NotImplementedException.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Method to update a resource; may throw exceptions similar to 'getOne'.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Provides validation rules for the 'update' method, may throw NotImplementedException.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Method to delete a resource; may throw exceptions for not found, not implemented, or forbidden.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Provides validation rules for the 'delete' method, may throw NotImplementedException.
